summary.text: Frank Henderson is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Samantha Poetter Parshall.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Army veteran and union member who has worked in manufacturing for more than 26 years.

paragraphs.text: Frank Henderson said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was raised on his family's farm in Missouri and served in the U.S. Army as a member of the Signal Corps before beginning a career in manufacturing.
He said he has been a union member and representative for more than 26 years, and that he is a husband and father of six who lives in Louisburg.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for District 6 on August 4, 2026.
Henderson listed his campaign messages as worker protections, fair wages and the right to organize; lower costs for families, farmers and small businesses; and fully funding public schools.
He said he supports strengthening special education and keeping rural and neighborhood schools open.
